text:
Noah: Hey finance — small issue from my Tokyo trip. Took a late-night taxi from Narita, driver said card machine down and I paid 4,200 JPY cash. No itemized receipt, just a handwritten slip. Need to expense.
Noah: I uploaded a photo of the slip to Expensify, it's pretty basic: date, amount, driver initials, no company stamp.
JESS: @Noah our policy requires a merchant receipt for taxis when available. If only a handwritten slip exists, we need manager attestation and a short explanation.
Noah: @Hana (manager) I had to rush to a client dinner and the driver insisted cash. Can you confirm this was business and OK to reimburse?
Hana: Confirmed — I asked Noah to prioritize the client meeting. Approve reimbursement of 4,200 JPY. Posting here so finance has written approval.
Financebot: Reminder: cash taxi receipts without GST/VAT or merchant header require manager sign-off and a short note describing reason. Reimbursement will be converted at bank FX rate on expense date.
JESS: Thanks @Hana. @Noah set the Expensify claim to 4,200 JPY, attach the photo, include Hana's approval text, and select category travel:ground-transport. Finance will process as long as documentation is attached. If you can get a digital receipt from the taxi company later, upload and we'll update.
Noah: Uploaded Hana's approval and marked claim as pending. Appreciate the quick help.
